thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx + connection errors observed for gateway-usw2-ingress. Error rate ~18% across gateway instances, queueing noticed at the edge. Paging @Priya (oncall).

Priya (oncall): on it. Jumping in — thanks. Any quick context on customer-facing impact?

Li (support): we're seeing a small set of live customer sessions failing with 502/504; a few customers reporting slow responses. Support is triaging customers with >10% failed requests.

Sam (infra): I can see the ingress pool in us-west-2 showing elevated queue lengths and many inflight conns in TIME_WAIT. Looks like a backlog at the gateway fronting layer.

Marco (runtime): can you paste the gateway logs for one example instance? want to see upstream latency and conn resets.

Sam (infra): here — tail from gateway-usw2-01 (last 2m):

```
[12:03:10] WARN upstream: connection reset by peer (upstream=ml-worker-usw2-*)
[12:03:15] ERROR request handler: upstream timeout after 8s
[12:03:22] WARN accept queue full: dropped conn
[12:03:27] INFO inflight: 312 queue: 178
```

Priya (oncall): interesting — there are both upstream resets and the gateway itself reporting accept queue full. Could be a downstream congestion (ml workers) or a kernel socket limit on gateways.

Jen (SRE): checking system metrics. gateway-usw2 instances show high accept queue length and fd usage near limit on three nodes. Also noticing a spike in egress saturation to our worker pool.

Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) expand gateway fleet in us-west-2, 2) shift routing for new sessions to us-west-1/us-east-1 temporarily, 3) enable degraded-mode routing (shorter timeouts) for non-priority traffic.

Marco (runtime): we have a routing policy that can reroute non-SLA traffic to standby regions. I can kick that but need approvals. What about autoscale? Are there spare capacity in the dedicated edgepool?

Sam (infra): edgepool has limited spare capacity right now, but we can spin up 4 more gateways in ~120s if we bump capacity. Pushing now.

DeployBot: triggered scale-up: provisioning 4 instances in pool edgepool-usw2 (request id abc123). ETA ~95s.

Priya (oncall): good. Marco — can you start a temporary traffic-steer for 20% of new sessions to us-east-1? That should reduce load on us-west-2 ingress while instances start.

Marco (runtime): doing it. applying policy: ``policy:set route:ingress:steer(us-west-2->us-east-1) weight=20% ttl=15m``

Marco (runtime): applied. will monitor.

Sam (infra): new instances are starting. Meanwhile I'm going to check and increase `somaxconn` and fd ulimits on the remaining nodes to buy us time.

Priya (oncall): checklist: 1) scale gateways (in progress), 2) adjust kernel listen queue ulimits (Sam), 3) reroute 20% (Marco), 4) identify worker-side bottleneck (Jen).

Jen (SRE): gathering worker metrics — ml-worker-usw2 group shows CPU low but network Rx queue growing and connection churn. A subset of worker nodes shows repeated TLS renegotiation logs.

Li (support): flagging two enterprise customers with >15% failed requests. We should coordinate proactive messages if this persists.

Priya (oncall): agreed. Li, draft a short status update: "We're seeing elevated gateway errors in us-west-2, routing mitigation in progress. We'll follow up in 30m or on resolution." Keep it generic.

Li (support): drafting now and will post to affected customers channel once we have a mitigation ETA.

Sam (infra): changed sysctl net.core.somaxconn=4096 and net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=2048 on all gateway nodes. Restarting gateway process gracefully on two nodes at a time.

Marco (runtime): I see a drop in queueing after the first restart. Error rate falling from 18% -> 12% in the last 90s.

IncidentBot: Metric window update: error_rate_usw2=11.6% (was 18%). ingress_queue_mean=70 (was 178).

Priya (oncall): good progress. Sam keep rolling restarts, Marco keep the 20% steer until error_rate <3% for 10m. Jen keep digging into worker TLS churn.

Jen (SRE): quick note: a new kernel upgrade rolled out yesterday to a subset of worker nodes (kmod openssl 1.1.1->1.1.2). Correlating nodes with TLS renegotiation — looks like 7 nodes got the roll. I'm spinning up a smoke group without that kernel to confirm.

Marco (runtime): if the worker kernel is causing conn resets, we should fail traffic back to older worker pool or mark problematic nodes draining. I'll prepare an agent to mark nodes unhealthy in the lb if repeated reset >5/min.

Priya (oncall): do that. Also prioritize customer-facing sessions: set route priority for enterprise customers to prefer us-east-1 until us-west-2 stable.

Sam (infra): remaining restarts complete. fd usage back to normal. new gateways spun up and joined. current inflight 84 queue 22.

Marco (runtime): steering off now (reducing from 20% -> 0 over 2 min) per Priya, keeping enterprise steer until safe.

IncidentBot: Metric window update: error_rate_usw2=2.8% ingress_queue_mean=12. TTL timers: enterprise_steer=ON.

Li (support): posting customer note now: "We experienced elevated gateway errors in us-west-2 beginning ~12:00 UTC. Routing mitigations completed and error rates are back to baseline. Our oncall team is monitoring; we'll send a follow-up with root cause once confirmed." :white_check_mark:

Priya (oncall): handing off to Marco for root-cause and follow-up analysis. I'm going offline for incident cooldown. @Marco please own postmortem and RCA timeline.

Marco (runtime): taking it. immediate next steps: 1) correlate worker kernel rollout with conn resets, 2) collect pcap samples from affected worker subset, 3) run a staged rollback of the kernel on one cluster to verify. I'll schedule a postmortem meeting for tomorrow.

Jen (SRE): I'll help with kernel artifact analysis and provide node lists and logs.

Li (support): I'll prepare impacted-customer list + request IDs for billing/credit evaluation.

Sam (infra): leaving sysctl adjustments documented in infra runbook; we should consider a permanent increase or circuit-breaker to auto-scale earlier.

Priya (oncall): thanks team — great coordination. Closing the paging loop. If anything flares, wake me.

Marco (runtime): noted. creating RCA draft in #incidents-rca and will attach timelines and mitigation steps. Will include recommended change: add preflight check for kernel rollouts and a canary for TLS behaviour.

IncidentBot: Incident closed by Priya (oncall). Duration: 00:36. Post-incident tag: investigation-required.
